text: Three capstone projects, built in sequence, each one forcing everything from this track — system design, Databricks, Fabric, and the exam material — to work together on a single real system.
Project 1 is a real-time retail analytics platform. Project 2 is a multi-source data warehouse migration. Project 3 is a streaming fraud detector. They're sequential, not parallel.
Every project runs the same shape: a kickoff that applies Chapter 1's system-design process, build lessons layer by layer, a hardening lesson, and a wrap-up retrospective.
Every build lesson names the specific prior lesson a decision comes from. A project you can't explain using named techniques is one you copied steps for, not one you understood.
Three projects, one format: kickoff, build, wrap-up. Next up: Project 1 kickoff — scoping a real-time retail analytics platform from scratch.
